Tucked behind the upscale 30Avenue Shops lies a quiet, storybook neighborhood with cobblestone streets, friendly neighbors, and a HEATED community pool. You will be staying in the closest house to the pool, just a few steps outside its backdoor, is bright, modern, and insta-worthy. It's also where you'll call home for your stay in Inlet Beach!

— HEATED POOL —
The community pool is now HEATED! Not only can you relax on your screened-in back porch with direct views of the pool, but now you can enjoy swimming for even more of the year. The current heated schedule includes March 1st thru April 30th, October 3rd thru Dec 1st, Dec 22nd thru Jan 5th. Pool heating is managed by the neighborhood association and is subject to change. No refunds will be issued if the pool does not reach a specific temperature or becomes temporarily unavailable.

Our home is so close to everything yet hidden enough from the noisy hustle and bustle of busy-season beach crowds. It's charming, cozy, private, and modern. You'll love it here!

The recently completed $5 million pedestrian tunnel under Highway 98 now offers a safe and convenient connection from Inlet Beach to Rosemary community. This project means our guests can enjoy a quick, enjoyable walk to all the attractions of Rosemary—boutique shops, restaurants, and the beautiful 30A area—without the paying Rosemary Beach high prices for rentals or getting caught in all the congestion and traffic. After a day of exploring, retreat to the tranquility of our rental, and your own private oasis of our screened in porch directly overlooking the pool. Allowing you to enjoy all the benefits of 30A living without the drawbacks. Your peaceful coastal getaway just got even better!

Borrow our six beach cruisers and take a short, 3-minute bike ride to the beach or the picturesque Rosemary town square. Just coast through the secret, back entrance to 30Avenue, and wander down the historic 30A street to enjoy one-of-a-kind boutiques and local flavors. Or use our personal gate code to access the community pool anytime. You could even enjoy the warm days from the comfort of our private, screened porch that overlooks the pool. And if you forgot your beach chairs or towels, we've got plenty you could use.

The house is located in a private HOA residential community in the charming subdivision, West Shore Place. Access your private driveway and use the keyless entry for a truly private escape.

YOUR PET
You are welcome to bring your hypoallergenic, non-shedding dogs on vacation, but they must be approved at the time of booking. No German Shepherds, Golden Retrievers, Pit Bulls, ChowChows, Great Pyrenees, Saint Bernards, Rottweilers, Labrador Retrievers, Siberian Huskies, or Dobermans. The dog fee is $100, with a maximum of two dogs. (Dogs weighing 30 lbs. max). Your dog is not allowed on the screened in porch or in the pool area. If your dog tends to bark when you leave it alone, please consider the neighbors. We live in a quiet neighborhood. Guests are responsible for any damages incurred.

If you bring a dog to the property that wasn’t pre-approved, we have the right to terminate your stay without a refund. In some instances, we may choose to grant approval after the fact, but the fee would be $100 per day per dog.

NOTE: Dogs are not allowed on the beaches on 30a. Only homeowners are allowed to purchase permits for their personal dogs. Renters are not allowed to acquire permits. This is a Walton County ordinance and applies to all of 30a.

NO CATS ALLOWED. An automatic $500 fine will be imposed, and you will be required to vacate the property immediately.
**Special note on service animals**: If you are bringing a service animal, the service animal cannot be left alone at the property and must be with you at all times. A service animal must not be:
Out of control
Un-housebroken
Left alone at the listing without prior approval
Allowed into areas that are considered unauthorized to the guest
Allowed in a public space without being harnessed, leashed, or tethered and not under the guest’s control
As per service animal guidelines, if you are bringing a service animal, you must prove the following information:
What work or task the service animal has been trained to perform
Whether the guest requires their service animal because of a disability
What work or task the service animal has been trained to perform

- Outdoor Security Cameras - Active at front porch entry door, parking area, and back door for the safety and the security of the property.

-House Rules -
This home is located in an HOA Community and each guest must follow the same rules as the owners. Please make yourself familiar with the following HOA Community rules:
*no parking on the street at any time
*no trailers, boats, jet skis, commercial trucks in neighborhood
*no blocking sidewalk
*two vehicle spaces on your driveway
*motor vehicles must be properly muffled, licensed, and maintained to not create unnecessary disturbance
*all trash must be kept in covered containers and hidden from public view except on pickup day.
*bring trash receptacles to road on Tuesday and Friday and return to original spot after trash pickup
*swimming pool hours 9:00am to 9:00pm
*pool rules are posted inside pool fence and to be followed by every person
*pets must be on a leash or carried at all times when outside the residence and must be under control at all times.
*pet owners must immediately collect and properly dispose of pet wastes. Minimum fine of $25 if not taken care of.
*pets are not allowed in the pool area
*note: dogs are not allowed on any beaches on 30a)
*there is a 10:00pm noise ordinance. Quiet hours at 10:00pm to 7:00am seven days per week.
*hanging wet towels and clothing on porches, decks and fences is not permitted
*fireworks are not permitted and are illegal in West Shore Place community.
*no open flames inside the house or on the back screened-in porch / no candles / no smoking or vaping / no drugs / no firearms.
*no confetti, glitter or taping things to the walls.
*EV charging not allowed unless pre-approved. Additional fee may apply.
*crypto mining or other electricity intensive activities not allowed unless pre-approved.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text: The location of 30A Hideaway is great for easy access to the 30Avenue shopping district with neat restaurants and shops. The new pedestrian tunnel under Hwy 98 makes it super nice for walks and bike rides to Rosemary Beach and beyond. The house was very clean and the most stocked with supplies we’ve ever experienced in a VRBO home. The host, Mike, was very pleasant and offered assistance with anything we may need regarding the house, everything was so nice and everything so well organized, no assistance was needed. We were sad to have to leave and are already planning a return trip.
